title: Anterolateral Watson Jones Approach Versus Transgluteal Approach for Uncemented Hemi- Arthroplasty in Displaced Femoral Neck Fracture
brief_summary: Hemiarthroplasty is a well established treatment of Femoral Neck Fractures in the Elderly. During the last decade the use of Minimal Invasive Surgical( MIS) approaches have been increasing. Our hypothesis is that Patients with a Femoral Neck Fracture may benefit from a MIS approach.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Patients 70- 85 Years of Age -

Exclusion Criteria:

Dementia, Infection Not Suitable for Hemiarthroplasty
